isolation: apple-container renders `container run` argv and a
launchd plist through backends/apple_container.py, not the
quadlet templates. The cage.yaml-derived artifacts in this
directory (warnings, resolved config, proxy-config,
dns-allowlist, placeholders) still apply.

What that backend renders INSTEAD is recorded separately, in
tests/fixtures/apple-container/ (generated by
scripts/gen-apple-container-fixtures.py, which drives the same
Python with platform.system() patched to Darwin). Every case in
this directory appears there: the three egress-config files
under egress-config/<case>/, and the volume/tmpfs derivations
in volumes.json under the id `corpus:<case>`.
